intent.audience: Thai viewers of drama/story clips, phone and TV
intent.message: An old abandoned Thai wooden house that nobody has entered for years — something is waiting inside.
intent.scene_objective: establishing shot of the haunted location
constraints: empty plate for characters and subtitles later

direction.visual_metaphor: the path is swallowed by nature; the house has closed its eyes

primary_focal_point.what: an abandoned old Thai stilt house in the style of traditional central Thailand: built of dark weathered teak, lifted two metres above the ground on many tall round pillars, a very steep tall roof whose gable boards sweep up into slender curved horns at the tips, walls of rectangular framed teak panels, a dark open doorway at the top of steep wooden stairs, vines and roots climbing the pillars
primary_focal_point.how_emphasised: the only clear dark shape in pale fog, darkest value at the open doorway

viewing_path: overgrown brick path in the foreground
the broken roof against the fog
blueprint.subject_placement: the house sits in the centre at the end of the path

depth_layers.foreground: tall wild grass and a cracked brick path, a rusty fallen gate
depth_layers.midground: the stilt house and a dead banana tree
depth_layers.background: tall trees fading into thick grey-blue fog

blueprint.negative_space: pale fog in the upper sky
blueprint.value_plan: mid-light fog, the house a dark silhouette, the doorway the darkest point

lighting.key_direction: dim dusk light diffused through fog from behind the house

environment: a rural village in central Thailand at dusk, the house deep in an overgrown garden

prompt.avoid: The scene is completely empty of people and animals; the image has no letters or signs

critique.problem: the house looks intact and the path is clean — "abandoned" reads weakly
critique.likely_cause: Thai-house wording took priority; overgrowth words dropped in the rewrite
critique.fix: img2img at denoise ~0.45 adding broken panels, missing roof tiles, weeds over the path
critique.side_effects: may change the clean silhouette that makes it read as Thai

critique.where: doorway at the top of the stairs (x 0.5, y 0.45)
critique.problem: the dark doorway is not a saliency peak; the path (0.86) and roof tip (0.83) lead
critique.likely_cause: doorway small and mid-grey in fog
critique.fix: darken the doorway in grade, or a faint warm glow inside
critique.side_effects: a glow changes the mood toward B

score.rater: claude (provisional AI judgement, no viewer test)
